# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 94 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 94 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_094_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — Who Is the Son of God?

**1** "First, let me tell you who I am," he said. "Please, Lord — tell me," I replied. "Who do you think the tall man is — the one who bears the name of the Son of God?" **2** "He is the Son of God," I said, "the one clothed in the Holy Spirit." "Exactly right," he said. "The Son of God is the one who is clothed in the Holy Spirit. **3** Through him the entire world was created and is sustained. And here is something important: he existed before all creation, and through him God laid the very foundations of everything. He himself is the foundation stone and the cornerstone." **4** "But why does he sometimes appear as an old man and sometimes as a young man?" I asked. "Because the Son of God existed before all time," he replied, "and appeared to his people at both ends of history. He appeared as ancient to those who belonged to the old covenant, and as young and new to those who belong to the new. **5** What you are witnessing is the new creation — he renews all things and makes everything new. **6** The old order has run its course and passed away. And he chose twelve people and gave them authority to live by his commandments. After them, twelve more were appointed, and then seven. All of them walked in the power of the Son of God."

---

*PNEUMA renders the Shepherd's christological statement as a clear theological declaration — pre-existence, creative agency, foundation, cornerstone — and the three tiers of twelve + twelve + seven as the apostolic chain.*
